summary: The IDF 98th Division completed operational deployment to Judea and Samaria while two IDF soldiers were killed in a drone crash in northern Gaza, marking an escalation on multiple fronts. Iran-US nuclear negotiations face mounting obstacles as Gulf states oppose Hormuz strait concessions and regional airport closures disrupt Iranian flights. Saudi Arabia intensified airstrikes on Yemen while simultaneously preparing its military for potential conflict with Houthi forces.
key_points: IDF 98th Division completed operational deployment and assumed command over two brigades in Judea and Samaria to enhance security and counterterrorism, per IDF directive from Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir (Source: @New_security8200/203946).

Two IDF soldiers from Battalion 7007, 16th Brigade, were killed when a drone crashed into their base in northern Gaza during an approved operational mission, after which they approached the crashed drone which then exploded (Source: @pkpoi/144073).

Saudi Arabia conducted 14 airstrikes and missile launches from F-15 and Typhoon aircraft and from Najran over 24 hours, targeting Yemeni governorates of Taiz, Amran, Ma'rib, and Saada, bringing total strikes since escalation began to 1,032 (Source: @naya_foriraq/91569).

US technical experts joined Iran-US negotiations in New York after Iranian delegation travel visas were rapidly issued, following initial US reluctance, according to Al Jazeera reporter (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81483).

Gulf states, led by Saudi Arabia and UAE, are pressuring the Trump administration to maintain economic pressure on Iran and reject Hormuz strait concessions, citing Tehran's attacks on Saudi vessels and support for Houthis as evidence of bad faith (Source: @asafroz/53788).

Syrian gasoline is being transported by road into Iraq via a two-way energy corridor after Strait of Hormuz shipping disruption, with the first shipment totaling approximately 32,800 metric tons moved by 77 tanker trucks (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7531).

IDF dismantled an approximately 2-kilometer underground terror tunnel in southern Gaza within the Yellow Line area as part of operations to clear terrorist infrastructure (Source: @shin_persian/10437).

sections.executive_summary: The IDF 98th Division completed operational deployment to Judea and Samaria while two soldiers were killed in a drone crash in northern Gaza, signaling intensified ground operations. Iran-US negotiations face mounting obstacles as Gulf states oppose Hormuz concessions and regional airports continue suspending Iranian flights. Saudi Arabia has conducted over 1,000 strikes on Yemen while preparing its military for potential Houthi conflict.
iran: US warships have reportedly moved the majority of their vessels away from Iranian coasts, where they were previously stationed to support the maritime blockade of Iran, according to analyst reports (Source: @kianmeli1/92490).

Iran tested the Qasem Basir anti-ship ballistic missile in early September, which has a range of approximately 1,200 kilometers covering large portions of the Gulf of Oman and parts of the Arabian Sea, potentially threatening US naval vessels operating in the region (Source: @kianmeli1/92490).

Iran's internet service was restored to normal after disruptions to international communication routes that had degraded internet quality across Iran were resolved, according to the head of the Communications Infrastructure Company (Source: @SharghDaily/185767).
Erbil and Sulaymaniyah airports in Iraqi Kurdistan suspended Iranian airline flights since Friday, September 5, according to Reuters citing two informed sources (Source: @VahidOnline/78528).

Najaf International Airport announced the suspension of all flights to and from Iran, coinciding with new US sanctions on Iran's aviation industry, with the suspension to remain until further notice (Source: @mamlekate/104624).

Mohammad Mokhber, adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader, warned that if restrictions on Iranian flights continue, no country in the region will be able to benefit from flight services, stating 'flights in the region are either open to everyone or no one' (Source: @shin_persian/10432).
Saudi Arabia's Grand Mufti has asked military forces to prepare for martyrdom operations in battle against the Houthis, according to reports (Source: @kianmeli1/92487).
Trump told Chinese President Xi Jinping that any support for Tehran is completely unacceptable, according to reports (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81470).

A senior former CIA official claimed that Israel recruited thousands of Afghan nationals in Iran for $100 each for espionage purposes, citing the large number of Afghan refugees in Iran who will never obtain Iranian citizenship (Source: @kianmeli1/92494).
israel: IDF 98th Division completed operational deployment ahead of schedule and assumed command over the 98th Division and the regional brigades of Etzion and Judea in Judea and Samaria, operating in partnership for defense and offense to enhance security and counterterrorism, per directive from IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir (Source: @New_security8200/203946).

Two IDF soldiers, Sergeant Major Naveh Kalai, age 24, and Sergeant Major Ofek Moalem, age 23, both from Battalion 7007 of the 16th Brigade, were killed when a drone crashed into their base in northern Gaza during a pre-approved operational mission; they approached the crashed drone which then exploded, and both were evacuated to Barzilai Hospital where their deaths were confirmed (Source: @pkpoi/144073).

IDF killed two Hamas operatives in Gaza: Jabr Moqbel, head of the Moqbel money exchange network that transferred millions of shekels in foreign currency to Hamas, in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah, and Hasan al-Batta, a Hamas sniper operative, in southern Gaza's Khan Younis (Source: @idf_telegram/25212).
IDF razed an approximately 2-kilometer underground terror tunnel in southern Gaza within the Yellow Line area as part of operations to clear terrorist infrastructure (Source: @shin_persian/10437).

IDF and Magav sealed the home of the shooter who carried out the shooting attack in Neve Tzuf earlier in the week, in which Nethanel Shokerron z"l was killed; the shooter was wounded by IDF fire during the attack and arrested, with the sealing conducted ahead of the house demolition per a temporary seizure order signed by the Central Command chief (Source: @yediotnews25/135354).
A stabbing incident was reported in the Neve Tzuf area in Netivot, with a wounded person present and rescue and police forces at the scene (Source: @yediotnews25/135348).
A drone crashed inside an IDF base; soldiers Nadav and Ofek approached to inspect it and it subsequently exploded (Source: @amitsegal/65186).
gaza_west_bank: IDF dismantled an approximately 2-kilometer underground terror tunnel in southern Gaza within the Yellow Line area as part of operations to clear terrorist infrastructure (Source: @shin_persian/10437).

IDF killed two Hamas operatives in Gaza: Jabr Moqbel, identified as a Hamas member and head of the Moqbel money exchange network that transferred millions of shekels in foreign currency to Hamas to finance terrorists and restore military infrastructure, in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah; and Hasan al-Batta, a Hamas sniper operative, in southern Gaza's Khan Younis, both killed from the air to remove the threat (Source: @manniefabian/59239).

IDF spokesperson confirmed the killing of two Hamas terrorists including a commander who participated in transferring millions of shekels to the organization; the IDF continues to focus efforts on striking Hamas's financing capabilities to prevent restoration of military infrastructure and capabilities, with forces in the Southern Command deployed according to the agreement (Source: @idf_telegram/25212).

Two IDF soldiers from Battalion 7007, 16th Brigade, were killed in a drone crash at an IDF base in northern Gaza during a pre-approved operational mission; the soldiers approached the crashed drone which then exploded, and both were treated on-site and evacuated to Barzilai Hospital where their deaths were confirmed; no additional casualties were reported (Source: @pkpoi/144073).

IDF and Magav sealed the home of the shooter who carried out the shooting attack in Neve Tzuf, in which Nethanel Shokerron z"l was killed, ahead of its demolition following a temporary seizure order signed by the Central Command chief (Source: @yediotnews25/135354).
IDF razed a two-kilometer tunnel in the IDF-held portion of the Gaza Strip amid efforts to clear areas under Israeli control of Hamas infrastructure (Source: @manniefabian/59240).
lebanon: Artillery shelling was reported in Zouta al-Sharqiya, with direct maps published showing affected areas (Source: @redlinkleb/45098).
Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Sulouqi, with direct maps published showing affected areas (Source: @redlinkleb/45074).
The enemy dropped phosphorus bombs on the outskirts of Zouta al-Sharqiya (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394825).

Hostile drone activity was reported in the skies of southern Lebanon, with affected areas mapped and residents advised to take precautions; the number of red circles indicates the number of affected areas rather than the number of drones (Source: @redlinkleb/45066).
A sweep with machine guns was conducted toward the town of Beit Yahoun (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394815).

Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam addressed the UN General Assembly, stating that all weapons in the country must be in the hands of the government, and that there will be no stability in Lebanon without stability in the region (Source: @N12chat/227097).
Red Alert Lebanon continues its coverage operations and called for donations to support its costs (Source: @redlinkleb/45087).
syria_iraq: Saudi Arabia conducted 14 airstrikes and missile launches over 24 hours using F-15 and Typhoon aircraft from Khamis Mushait and Taif bases, with missile strikes from Najran, targeting Yemeni governorates of Taiz, Amran, Ma'rib, and Saada, bringing total strikes since escalation began to 1,032 (Source: @naya_foriraq/91569).
The US State Department stated it wants to see a sovereign Iraq disarmed of Iranian proxies (Source: @naya_foriraq/91580).
Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaydi stated there will be no stability in the region until a solution is found for the Palestinian issue (Source: @N12chat/227089).

Former Iraqi Prime Minister Adel Abdul Mahdi stated that if the region is seen as united and undivided, and what happens to the Israeli and American enemy and the rise of resistance forces, they are definitely heading toward victory (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394830).

Syrian gasoline is being transported by road into Iraq creating a two-way energy corridor after Strait of Hormuz shipping disruption, with the first shipment totaling approximately 32,800 metric tons and 77 tanker trucks already leaving Syria for Iraq (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7531).

Iraqchi, at the ECO foreign ministers meeting, stated that the world faces increasing uncertainty and fragmentation, and that Iran is committed to strengthening regional cooperation and integration, believing that the ECO can play a more active role in advancing economic and trade cooperation (Source: @SharghDaily/185756).
A Sema expert stated that the time to attack regional airports has arrived (Source: @kianmeli1/92483).
gulf_states: Gulf states, led by Saudi Arabia and the UAE, are pressuring the Trump administration to continue economic pressure on Iran and reject concessions that would ease sanctions or the maritime blockade, citing Tehran's attacks on Saudi vessels in the strait and its support for the Houthis as evidence of bad faith (Source: @asafroz/53788).

Saudi Arabia and the UAE are applying pressure on the Trump administration to maintain economic pressure on Iran rather than agree to concessions, while Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman told American officials that the US must continue the blockade until Iran is forced to sign a new agreement (Source: @asafroz/53788).

Oman and Qatar argue that the region has already suffered significant damage and that proposals for a gradual opening of the Strait of Hormuz and cessation of attacks on Gulf states are the only practical path to ending the confrontation (Source: @asafroz/53788).

US intelligence assesses that Saudi Arabia has not ruled out developing nuclear weapons, as the Trump administration supports a civilian Saudi nuclear program that could eventually allow uranium enrichment up to 20% (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7534).
Saudi Arabia's Grand Mufti has asked military forces to prepare for martyrdom operations in battle against the Houthis (Source: @kianmeli1/92487).
Gulf states generally agree that Trump should not militarily escalate against Iran, but Saudi Arabia and the UAE are pushing for continued economic pressure (Source: @asafroz/53788).
key_developments: IDF 98th Division completed operational deployment to Judea and Samaria assuming command over regional brigades under Chief of Staff Zamir's directive, enhancing counterterrorism capabilities in the West Bank (Source: @New_security8200/203946).

Two IDF soldiers killed in drone crash at northern Gaza base during approved operation; soldiers approached crashed drone which exploded, prompting IDF to halt use of this drone type pending investigation (Source: @pkpoi/144073).

Saudi Arabia conducted 14 airstrikes and missiles on Yemeni governorates in 24 hours, bringing total strikes since escalation to 1,032, using F-15 and Typhoon aircraft from Khamis Mushait and Taif bases (Source: @naya_foriraq/91569).

US technical experts joined Iran-US negotiations in New York after Iranian delegation visas were rapidly issued, signaling progress in diplomatic channels despite Gulf state opposition to concessions (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81483).

Gulf states led by Saudi Arabia and UAE oppose Hormuz strait concessions to Iran, citing attacks on Saudi vessels and Houthi support as evidence of Tehran's bad faith, while Oman and Qatar advocate gradual opening (Source: @asafroz/53788).

Syrian gasoline transported by road to Iraq via two-way energy corridor after Hormuz disruption, with first shipment of approximately 32,800 metric tons moved by 77 tanker trucks (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7531).
IDF dismantled approximately 2-kilometer underground terror tunnel in southern Gaza's Yellow Line area as part of infrastructure-clearing operations (Source: @shin_persian/10437).
sections.threat_assessment: Iran's military capabilities present a growing threat to regional stability, with the Qasem Basir anti-ship ballistic missile's approximately 1,200-kilometer range covering US naval assets in the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea, while Iran has reportedly moved warships away from Iranian coasts. The continued suspension of Iranian flights at regional airports including Erbil, Sulaymaniyah, and Najaf signals deepening diplomatic isolation, compounded by Mohammad Mokhber's warning that regional flight services will be suspended entirely if Iran is targeted. Saudi Arabia's military preparations for conflict with the Houthis, including the Grand Mufti's call for martyrdom operations, indicate a multi-front threat environment.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are divided in their approach to Iran, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE pushing for continued economic pressure and rejecting Hormuz concessions, while Oman and Qatar advocate for a gradual opening of the strait and cessation of attacks. Saudi Arabia has intensified its military campaign in Yemen with over 1,000 cumulative strikes, while simultaneously preparing its forces for potential Houthi conflict. The US administration faces competing pressures: Gulf allies demand sustained economic pressure on Iran, while diplomatic channels remain open with technical experts joining negotiations in New York. Iraq's leadership emphasizes that regional stability is contingent on resolving the Palestinian issue.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IDF's operational deployment of the 98th Division to Judea and Samaria signals a significant escalation in West Bank counterterrorism operations, with the division assuming command over Etzion and Judea brigades. The killing of two IDF soldiers in a drone crash in northern Gaza raises questions about drone operational safety, prompting IDF to suspend use of the affected drone type pending investigation. The transfer of Syrian gasoline to Iraq via road corridors indicates that the Strait of Hormuz disruption is driving new energy logistics patterns, with approximately 32,800 metric tons already moved by 77 tanker trucks. US intelligence assessments of Saudi Arabia's potential nuclear weapons development, alongside support for a civilian program allowing uranium enrichment up to 20%, represent a significant shift in regional non-proliferation dynamics.
